faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a Marbella boat rental in 2045?
faq.a: The maximum group size depends on the boat. Most yachts in our fleet, like the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86, carry up to 12 passengers. Smaller boats, such as the Dubhe or Mariah SX21, are limited to 5 passengers. These limits are set by the boat's license and safety regulations, not by us.

faq.q: Can I exceed the group size limit if we all fit on the boat?
faq.a: No. Group size limits are legally enforced by the Spanish Coast Guard and are based on the boat's certified passenger capacity. Exceeding them invalidates your insurance and puts everyone at risk. Even if you think there's space, we cannot allow more passengers than the listed maximum.

faq.q: Which Marbella boat rental is best for a group of 12?
faq.a: For a full group of 12, choose the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski), the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80, or Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús. If you're on a tighter budget, the Azimut 39 holds 11 passengers and starts at €749 for 2 hours.

faq.q: Are children counted in the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of any age count as passengers. The maximum capacity includes infants and toddlers. For safety, every person on board must have a life jacket, and the skipper is responsible for ensuring the total number never exceeds the limit. Plan your group accordingly.

faq.q: What is the cost for a large group charter in Marbella?
faq.a: For a 12-person yacht like the Mangusta 80, pricing is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and Azimut 39 (11 pax) are €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for 8 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, and VAT.

faq.q: Do all Marbella boat rentals include a skipper?
faq.a: Yes, every charter from our fleet includes a licensed skipper. You don't need a boating license to rent. The skipper handles navigation, docking, and safety, so you can relax and enjoy the coast. Skipper fees are already included in the quoted price.

faq.q: Can I book a boat for a wedding or corporate event with 15+ people?
faq.a: For groups larger than 12, we recommend splitting across two boats. For example, combine a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) with an Azimut 39 (11 pax) to accommodate up to 23 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp for a tailored multi-boat quote and coordinated departure.

faq.q: What happens if we show up with more people than the limit?
faq.a: If your group exceeds the boat's capacity, the skipper will not allow boarding. You may have to leave someone behind or rebook a larger boat, subject to availability. To avoid disappointment, confirm your final headcount when booking and notify us of any changes.

data.body_html:
Planning a group trip to Marbella in 2045? One of the first things you'll need to know is the Marbella boat rental group size limits — they're strict, legal, and vary by boat. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, a bachelor party, or a corporate day out, getting the capacity right is the difference between a smooth sail and a docked disaster. In this guide, we break down the exact passenger limits for every boat in our fleet, what they cost, and how to book for your group without a hitch.

Why Group Size Limits Exist

Group size limits aren't arbitrary. Every boat has a certified passenger capacity set by the Spanish maritime authority, based on stability, life raft capacity, and safety equipment. Exceeding it is illegal, voids your insurance, and puts everyone at risk. Our skippers enforce these limits without exception — even if there's a free seat. So when you see a max of 12 on a 24-metre yacht, that's the law, not a marketing ploy.

Our Fleet: Passenger Capacities at a Glance

Here's the full breakdown of our boats, all departing from Puerto Banús. Note that capacities include everyone on board — children, guests, and crew (skipper is extra).

What's Included in Every Charter

No matter which boat you choose, every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and the 21% Spanish IVA. That means no hidden extras — the price you see is the price you pay. For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, the 2-hour rate is €749, and the 8-hour rate is €2,299. For the Mangusta 80, the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719, and you get a jet ski thrown in free.

Choosing the Right Boat for Your Group Size

If you're a group of 5 or fewer, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 are nimble and budget-friendly. For 6, the Red Tide or Speedboat works well. For up to 10, consider the Fairline Targa or Lagoon 380. For 11, the Azimut 39 is ideal. And for a full 12, the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80, or Maiora 26m offer spacious decks and luxury amenities. If you're unsure, browse our full fleet to compare options.

Pricing for Groups: What to Expect

Our published rates are for the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39, and Mangusta 80. For all other boats, pricing is on request via WhatsApp — we'll tailor a quote based on your group size, duration, and route. As a rule of thumb, larger yachts cost more per hour but offer more space per person. For a 12-person group, the Mangusta 80 at €4,719 for 4 hours works out to under €100 per person — excellent value for a luxury day on the water.

Booking Tips for Large Groups

Book early, especially in peak season (June to September), when 12-person yachts sell out weeks ahead. Confirm your final headcount at least 48 hours before departure — if you need to add or remove people, let us know so we can adjust. If your group exceeds 12, we can arrange a multi-boat charter; for example, a Mangusta 80 plus an Azimut 39 can take up to 23 guests. For a custom quote, contact us via WhatsApp.

Popular Routes for Groups

From Puerto Banús, most groups head east to the beaches of Cabopino or west to Estepona and Sotogrande. For a shorter trip, anchor at Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, where the water is calm and the views of La Concha are unbeatable. Your skipper will suggest the best route based on weather and your preferences. A 4-hour charter is perfect for a swim stop and lunch; 8 hours lets you explore further, maybe even reach the dunes of Cabopino.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the maximum group size for a Marbella boat rental in 2045?

The maximum group size depends on the boat. Most yachts in our fleet, like the Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, and Canados 86, carry up to 12 passengers. Smaller boats, such as the Dubhe or Mariah SX21, are limited to 5 passengers. These limits are set by the boat's license and safety regulations, not by us.

Can I exceed the group size limit if we all fit on the boat?

No. Group size limits are legally enforced by the Spanish Coast Guard and are based on the boat's certified passenger capacity. Exceeding them invalidates your insurance and puts everyone at risk. Even if you think there's space, we cannot allow more passengers than the listed maximum.

Which Marbella boat rental is best for a group of 12?

For a full group of 12, choose the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours, includes a free jet ski), the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, K80, or Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús. If you're on a tighter budget, the Azimut 39 holds 11 passengers and starts at €749 for 2 hours.

Are children counted in the group size limit?

Yes, children of any age count as passengers. The maximum capacity includes infants and toddlers. For safety, every person on board must have a life jacket, and the skipper is responsible for ensuring the total number never exceeds the limit. Plan your group accordingly.

What is the cost for a large group charter in Marbella?

For a 12-person yacht like the Mangusta 80, pricing is €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) and Azimut 39 (11 pax) are €749 for 2 hours, rising to €2,299 for 8 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, and VAT.

Do all Marbella boat rentals include a skipper?

Yes, every charter from our fleet includes a licensed skipper. You don't need a boating license to rent. The skipper handles navigation, docking, and safety, so you can relax and enjoy the coast. Skipper fees are already included in the quoted price.

Can I book a boat for a wedding or corporate event with 15+ people?

For groups larger than 12, we recommend splitting across two boats. For example, combine a Mangusta 80 (12 pax) with an Azimut 39 (11 pax) to accommodate up to 23 guests. Contact us via WhatsApp for a tailored multi-boat quote and coordinated departure.

What happens if we show up with more people than the limit?

If your group exceeds the boat's capacity, the skipper will not allow boarding. You may have to leave someone behind or rebook a larger boat, subject to availability. To avoid disappointment, confirm your final headcount when booking and notify us of any changes.
